note: City of Bayard's three gravel RV sites at the Swimming Pool Park (104 E 11th St), for short-term use. Dump station ~6 blocks away by the library. Sites are close-set parking spots on gravel, fine for a 23-ft rig. Backs to farmland, no water feature. --Claude
